news.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine responsible for sinking Russian warship in Libya – Europe live
news.summary: President says Kyiv responsible for sinking Merkury warship in Benghazi on Sunday and also drone attack on cargo vessel MV Angara Russian warship sinks in Benghazi after suspected Ukrainian drone attack Meanwhile, Ukraine’s SBU security service also commented on the sinking of the Russian warship in Libya. It said the corvette “regularly escorted enemy maritime convoys” and was part of Russia’s Black Sea Fleet. “We are ready to do this literally tomorrow. We have heard from our partners that they want to try to make it happen before Christmas. We hope it happens sooner, and we must come to this meeting with a clear agenda, prepared and agreed by all of us.” “ When the main question comes up, ‘what happens after this war?’, our common answer must be security. Real security. Security for Ukraine, security for all of Russia’s neighbours, security for Europe and the entire Euro-Atlantic area. This is only possible if we work together as closely as possible. I believe this is only possible when Russia has no temptation to test whether security guarantees really work with Nato.” Continue reading...
